settings.title: Minimum age
settings.text: ParaPatrol is made and dosed for children 3 and up. Please don’t give it to children under 3.

settings.title: Don’t exceed 1 mL a day
settings.text: More isn’t better. Stick to one dropper a day, and follow the 2–3 week routine with a break afterwards.

settings.title: Medication or health conditions
settings.text: If your child takes medication or has a health condition (especially heart, kidney or liver), check with your pediatrician first.

settings.title: Contains tree nuts
settings.text: Black walnut is a tree nut, so ParaPatrol isn’t suitable for children with a tree nut allergy.

settings.title: Stop if anything seems off
settings.text: Stop and call your doctor if your child has vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, blood in the stool, changes in urination or any unusual reaction.

settings.title: Not a medicine
settings.text: ParaPatrol is a herbal supplement, not a medicine or a worm treatment. If you think your child has worms, see your doctor.

settings.question: What does it taste like?
settings.answer: A natural raspberry flavor with a bitter blocker to soften the herbal taste. Some kids notice a hint of clove. Mixed into orange juice, milk or a berry smoothie, most kids drink it without a fuss.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last?
settings.answer: Each 30 mL (1 fl oz) bottle holds about 30 servings at 1 mL a day, enough for a full 2–3 week routine with some to spare.

settings.question: When is the best time to give it?
settings.answer: Most families use it in the morning juice or milk, but consistency matters more than the time of day. Pick a moment that fits your routine and stick with it.

settings.question: When will we notice a difference?
settings.answer: Every child is different. Many parents notice a more settled tummy and a better appetite within 1–2 weeks of daily use.*

settings.question: Can my child take it with other supplements or medication?
settings.answer: If your child takes any medication or other supplements, please check with your pediatrician or pharmacist before adding ParaPatrol.
